content:
Anya Patel: Quick FYI — pilot cohort (Cohort B) feedback jumped after we moved the enablement deck to v2 yesterday. A bunch of comments about 'missing checklist' and 'confusing next steps'.
Ryan Chen: ugh, saw that. Any specific steps they referenced?
Anya Patel: mostly around the 'post-demo setup' section. People expected a step-by-step checklist. A few mentioned renewal timeline confusion.
Tori Liu: @Ryan can you pull the feedback form exports? I want to see frequency by account size.
Ryan Chen: on it. exporting as CSV now -> `SELECT account_id, size_bucket, feedback_tag FROM enablement_feedback WHERE cohort='B'`
Marco Alvarez: Is this correlated with the CRM healthscore change we rolled last week? Could be noise.
Anya Patel: good call. Some of the accounts with lower healthscore also flagged onboarding confusion.
Tori Liu: proposal: quick playbook patch — add a 3-step 'post-demo checklist' template in playbooks and send to cohort B with an FYI nudge. Also create a short enablement video.
Ryan Chen: sounds good. I'll tag accounts with 'needs_post_demo_checklist' in CRM (small patch) — ETA 2h.
Anya Patel: can we gate the nudge by account healthscore < 0.6? want to prioritize at-risk renewals.
Marco Alvarez: yep that's fine. cs-ops-bot, can you schedule a runbook for the nudge to go out only to flagged accounts? :robot_face:
cs-ops-bot: scheduled runbook 'post-demo-nudge' for cohort=B where healthscore<0.6 — dry-run results emailed to #customer-success in 15m.
Tori Liu: sweet. also let's capture a sample of comments for Eval set. create a ticket? @Ryan
Ryan Chen: created ENG-TICKET-4521 with sample .csv and links to playbook draft.
Anya Patel: thanks — will update enablement owners and send a short note to PMs. if dry-run looks good, roll to cohort C next week. :thumbsup:
Tori Liu: moving to action. thanks team.
